name: MimicZip
tagline: Turn one or two photos into short template-based AI videos
description: MimicZip turns one or two photos into a short AI-generated video using a template. It is for people who want to make short visual clips from existing pictures. The workflow uses a selected template and the photo or photos needed for that template, with a video as the output. MimicZip is a paid service and does not offer a free preview. Check the official website for the available templates, current prices and purchase terms before deciding whether to pay.
